description: Read ONE JavaScript-heavy page (single-page apps, dashboards, content loaded after page load) in a real Chromium browser and get the rendered text with title, description, word_count and optional links. Slower and pricier than web-scrape: use it only when web-scrape returns little or no content. Params: url (required), include_links, max_chars (default 8000). Price: $0.009 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://example.com","max_chars":4000}.

include_links.description: If true, include up to 50 links found on the page

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return (truncated with …)

url.description: The URL to read and extract content from

name: webpage_reader
title: Webpage Reader
